messages:
auditor_jane: Hi team — onboarding question. Auditor asks for AC-2 evidence: RBAC change history for the last 6 months, KMS rotation events, and one incident playback showing a user access revocation. Prefer a single export (csv/json) or presigned S3 link. Which logs cover service-account role changes vs console user role edits?

maria_sec: hey @auditor_jane — welcome. We can provide a combined package. Quick clarifying q: do you need raw CloudTrail + internal RBAC events, or just the packaged, signed evidence bundle?

auditor_jane: raw logs preferred first, then a packaged bundle. Need timestamps and tamper-evidence (hashes) for chain-of-custody. Also auditor asks whether KMS key rotation events include key material destruction logs.

ajohnson: we track RBAC changes in two places: CloudTrail for IAM/service-account API calls and our internal auth-service audit for console/console-proxied UI edits. The mapping: CloudTrail -> aws:UpdateRole, aws:PutRolePolicy, sts:AssumeRole; auth-service -> role_assignment.created/updated/deleted in our internal audit index.

ajohnson: sample CloudTrail snippet for role change:
```json
{"eventTime":"2025-05-11T14:02:33Z","eventName":"UpdateRole","userIdentity":{"type":"AssumedRole","arn":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/infra-deploy"},"requestParameters":{"roleName":"sre-oncall"}}
```

maria_sec: for KMS rotation: Customer-managed CMKs in the acct show RotateKey creation events in CloudTrail and we emit kms.key.rotation events to our audit index with a rotation_id and vault_proof (sha256). Key material destruction (for ephemeral keys) is logged as kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion + KMS key state changes. Auditors usually accept the rotation event plus signed snapshot of the key metadata.

leo_sre: fyi, I kicked off an evidence export job this morning to S3 for the requested period — export id: exp-20250511-01. devops-bot will post the presigned links when ready. ETA ~30m.

devops-bot: Export job exp-20250511-01 started by leo_sre. Objects will be in s3://redwood-audit-exports/exp-20250511-01/. Generating presigned URLs...

devops-bot: Presigned URLs created (valid 7 days):
- RBAC_changes_2024-11_to_2025-05.json -> https://s3-presigned.example/exp-20250511-01/rbac.json
- KMS_rotations_2024-11_to_2025-05.json -> https://s3-presigned.example/exp-20250511-01/kms.json
- incident_playback_2025-03-08.json -> https://s3-presigned.example/exp-20250511-01/playback.json

auditor_jane: thanks. two quick follow-ups: 1) Do the RBAC export records include the actor's session id / request id to correlate with access logs? 2) For the incident playback, can you include redacted chat logs and the runbook steps invoked?

ajohnson: 1) yes — each RBAC record has fields: eventTime, actor.principal, sessionId, requestId, before/after role bindings. 2) playback includes runbook snapshot and redacted bridge/chat links. Example RBAC CSV headers: event_time,actor,session_id,request_id,action,resource,before,after,trace_hash

maria_sec: re: tamper-evidence we include a manifest.json with sha256 for every exported file and a top-level manifest.sig signed with our upload key. auditor can verify signatures. Example manifest line: 
`rbac.json  sha256:3b7f2c...`

auditor_jane: perfect. Please also add a short mapping doc that explains which control IDs these artifacts map to (SOC2 CC6.1 / ISO A.9.2 equivalents). We need to attach that mapping to evidence folder.

leo_sre: creating control_mapping.md and attaching to export. Sample mapping: CC6.1 -> RBAC_changes_*.json, CC8.2 -> KMS_rotations_*.json, IR-3 -> incident_playback_*.json

ajohnson: note — one caveat: internal auth-service logs older than 90 days are archived and require a two-step retrieval (longer lead). We have snapshots for last 6 months though, so should be fine. If auditor requests older than 6 months we'll need a 48h lead time.

auditor_jane: thanks for the heads up. This set looks good for initial fieldwork. I'll confirm after I run the verification. If I hit anything I'll ping back here. :thumbsup:

maria_sec: great — ping us if you need hash verification steps. Example verify command:
```bash
# verify manifest signature
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify pubkey.pem -signature manifest.sig manifest.json
```

leo_sre: export job will auto-delete presigned objects after 7 days; if you need longer we can create a signed evidence bundle for delivery.

auditor_jane: please do that if verification will take >7 days. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
